name: Bracket HQ
what_it_is: A web bracket maker for single and double elimination and round robin tournaments with live score updates.
pricing: Free tier with ads and up to 32 participants; Pro costs $8 per month or $48 billed annually and allows up to 64 participants.
notable: The site names no company or country.

facts.fact: Bracket HQ says it builds brackets of any size with single or double elimination and round robin tournaments with a leaderboard.
Bracket HQ lets organizers submit match scores and publish live bracket updates during a tournament.

The free tier is ad supported with unlimited brackets of up to 32 participants and basic themes; Pro is $8 per month or $4 per month billed annually at $48, with up to 64 participants, no ads, private brackets and scoring permissions.

name: Tournify
what_it_is: A tournament and league app for organizers with scheduling, registration, referee assignment and live scores, with a Pro plan for online esports events.
platforms: Web; Android and iOS apps for published events
pricing: Free for up to 8 teams per event; World Class is EUR 40 per event for up to 60 teams; Legendary is EUR 120 per event for unlimited teams; an online esports Pro plan is EUR 20 per event.
notable: The about page says development began in the summer of 2015 and customers are in more than 60 countries.

facts.fact: Tournify says it manages teams, builds match schedules and shares live results, with online registration that has built-in payment support.

Tournify lists Amateur (free, up to 8 teams), World Class (EUR 40 per event, up to 60 teams) and Legendary (EUR 120 per event, unlimited teams) and a Pro plan at EUR 20 per event for online esports tournaments that need no field planning.
The company says two students started the app in summer 2015 and that it serves more than 50 sports with customers in over 60 countries.
